overview: Close the remaining inbox/notification gaps: mark-all-read/archive-all buttons, read/unread filtering, notification grouping by document, unarchive flow, expanded deep-link coverage, per-type notification settings, and permanent delete.

scopeCuts: Focus on inbox parity inside mobile inbox routes, notification hooks/store, and adjacent components
Exclude server-side notification service changes, push delivery, and WS subscription overhaul

prerequisites: Existing scaffold/auth/api client/notification phases are already implemented in mobile/
WebSocket sidecar and notification invalidation rules are operational
useNotifications, useMarkAsRead, useArchiveNotifications, useMarkAllAsRead, useArchiveAll hooks already exist with optimistic updates
nonGoals: Modifying Huly server notification services or push delivery
Replacing polling-based unread sync with live WebSocket subscriptions
contracts: Server state remains in TanStack Query; UI state remains in Zustand
New inbox routes stay under mobile/src/app/(app)/inbox/**
Existing swipe-to-archive and bulk selection behavior must not regress
Mark-all and archive-all use existing hook functions

tasks.title: Add mark-all-read and archive-all UI buttons
tasks.description: Wire the existing useMarkAllAsRead() and useArchiveAll() hooks to visible UI actions in the inbox header.
acceptanceCriteria: Inbox header shows a menu with Mark All as Read and Archive All actions.
Both actions call the existing hook functions with optimistic updates and badge count sync.
Actions are disabled when there are no unread/unarchived notifications respectively.

tasks.title: Add read/unread filter toggle
tasks.description: Extend the notification filter UI to support filtering by read/unread status alongside existing type filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Filter bar adds a read/unread toggle that filters by isViewed status.
Read/unread filter composes with the existing type filter (e.g., unread mentions).
Switching between read/unread/all preserves type filter selection and scroll position.

tasks.title: Extend repository for read/unread and unarchive queries
tasks.description: Add repository-level query support for read/unread filtering and unarchive mutation.
acceptanceCriteria: getNotifications() accepts an optional readStatus filter mapping to isViewed query conditions.
New unarchiveNotifications(ids) repository method sets archived: false on given IDs.
useUnarchiveNotifications() hook wraps the method with optimistic cache updates that re-insert items.

tasks.title: Add unarchive flow
tasks.description: Expose an unarchive action so users can recover accidentally archived notifications via an undo toast.
acceptanceCriteria: After archiving via swipe, a brief undo toast appears (3s) allowing unarchive.
Undo calls useUnarchiveNotifications() and restores the item to its original position.
If the undo window expires, the archive is final and no stale item appears.

tasks.title: Add notification grouping by document context
tasks.description: Group notifications by their source document (DocNotifyContext) matching the web inbox pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Inbox list groups notifications by docNotifyContext, rendering a card per document with collapsed count.
Expanding a group card shows the individual notifications within that document context.
Documents with no displayable title show the object class as a fallback label, not a raw ref ID.

tasks.title: Expand deep-link coverage for notification routing
tasks.description: Add more object class mappings so fewer notifications fall through to the generic detail screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Router handles hr:class:Department, recruit:class:Applicant, document:class:Document, and board:class:Card with appropriate fallback routes.
Unknown object classes still fall back to the notification detail screen without crashing.
isKnownObjectClass() returns true for all newly added classes.

tasks.title: Add per-type notification settings UI
tasks.description: Expose fine-grained notification type toggles beyond the current 3 categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification settings screen shows per-type toggles within each category (e.g., under Chat: mentions, replies, reactions).
Preferences persist to AsyncStorage and are checked before showing foreground banners.
Disabling a parent category disables all child types; re-enabling restores previous per-type state.

tasks.title: Add delete notification action
tasks.description: Allow permanent deletion of notifications (not just archive).
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk action bar in selection mode shows a Delete action alongside Mark Read and Archive.
Delete uses removeDoc to permanently remove selected notifications with a confirmation dialog.
Attempting to delete already-removed notifications does not crash; stale IDs are silently skipped.

failureModes.detection: Badge shows wrong number after mark-all
failureModes.recovery: Invalidate unread count query on settle; re-sync from server

failureModes.failure: Unarchive restores notification to wrong position
failureModes.detection: Item appears at top instead of original sort position
failureModes.recovery: Insert at correct modifiedOn position or invalidate full list

failureModes.failure: Group card shows raw ref instead of title
failureModes.detection: DocNotifyContext has no resolved display name
failureModes.recovery: Fall back to objectClass human-readable label

failureModes.detection: Race between optimistic delete and server response
failureModes.recovery: Confirm by ID match before cache eviction; rollback on mismatch

failureModes.failure: Per-type toggle state desyncs from parent category
failureModes.recovery: Enforce parent-child invariant in toggle handler

testCoverageMap: TASK-001: mark-all-read/archive-all success + disabled state when empty
TASK-002: read/unread filter composability + scroll position preservation
TASK-003: repository readStatus filter + unarchive mutation + optimistic rollback
TASK-004: undo toast lifecycle + re-insertion position + expired-undo cleanup
TASK-005: group card rendering + expand/collapse + fallback title for unknown docs
TASK-006: new class mappings + unknown class fallback + isKnownObjectClass truth table
TASK-007: per-type toggle persistence + parent-child invariant + foreground banner suppression
TASK-008: delete confirmation + stale-ID skip + bulk delete with partial failure
